description: NVIDIA MotionBricks checkpoints for the Unitree G1 (pose, root and VQ-VAE models plus the G1 clip cache), read from NVIDIA's Git LFS objects in GR00T-WholeBodyControl at commit 45c03fac. Only the LFS checkpoints are addressed here; the plain git sidecars (hparams, configs, skeletons, statistics) are vendored in the recipe adapter and proven by check-vendored-upstream.
